correctness.rationale: The source defining set is reconstructed from the stated \(4\)-cyclotomic cosets. Its complement is \(\{10,11,14\}\), which gives parity-check polynomial \(h(x)=x^3+x+\omega\) in \(\mathbb F_4[x]\) and an exact degree-\(12\) generator. Direct evaluation verifies the zero set, the \(3\times15\) cyclic generator has zero Euclidean Gram matrix, and exhaustive enumeration of all \(64\) codewords gives \(1+45z^{11}+15z^{12}+3z^{15}\). The normalized columns are 15 distinct projective points whose six-point complement is exactly one line plus one off-line point. This geometry independently yields the weight multiplicities. Exhaustion of all 21 two-dimensional message subspaces gives \(d_2=14\), while full support gives \(d_3=15\).

The projective identification converts the Magma-reported parameter row into a transparent geometric model, explains the complete three-weight spectrum analytically, and determines the full generalized-weight hierarchy.
